title: DotheThing: An incredibly capable terminal-native autonomous AI agent
description:
An incredibly capable terminal-native autonomous AI agent. dothething is built by Riccardo Spagni, former lead maintainer of Monero. Tagline: "You describe the thing. It does the thing." A full-stack operator. Searches the web via SearXNG, bypasses bot detection with Camoufox, runs shell commands, sends and receives emails through AgentMail. Farms easy work to cheap models, autonomously upgrades to GPT-5.5 when stuck.

https://github.com/fluffypony/dothething

#github #opensource
